fee_notes: This is a Development Agent (DA) Program FDD, not a standard franchisee FDD. No royalty or marketing fund fees are disclosed in Item 6. Technology System Fee is $150 per year (not monthly). Other fees include: Interest at 18% or highest legal rate on overdue amounts; Late Payment Fee of $30/week on overdue amounts; Noncompliance Fee up to $500/incident; Annual conference registration estimated $300/person; Transfer Fee = $1,000 x number of Franchised Salons; Successor Development Term Fee = $1,000 x number of salons in successor term; Insurance Premiums estimated $2,000-$4,000 for 3 months plus 15% admin fee; Costs and Attorneys' Fees vary; Indemnification varies; Contribution for Legal Actions = 40% of reasonable attorneys' fees and costs.
raw_excerpt:
Technology System Fee | Currently, $150 per year | When billed | This fee provides for your right to use certain Technology System (as defined in Item 11) that we mandate and make available for use in the operation of your DA Business from time to time. The fee increase will be capped at 20% per year.
Interest | 18% or the highest legal rate | Upon demand | Payable on all overdue amounts; accrues from the due date until paid.
Late Payment Fee | $30 for each week (or portion thereof) | Upon demand | Payable on all overdue amounts; accrues from the due date until paid.
Noncompliance Fee | Up to $500 per incident | Upon demand | Payable if you (i) fail to comply with mandatory System Standards and you do not cure the non-compliance within the time period we require, (ii) after committing a default under the Development Agent Agreement, you commit the same default under the Development Agent Agreement within 6 months, or (iii) fail to operate your DA Business continuously during normal business hours during any day in which the DA Business is required to be open and operating without our consent.
Annual conference registration fee | Estimated to be $300 per person | Upon registration | We may charge you a reasonable registration fees for each individual that attends or participates in our annual conference. We may increase this fee up to 20% per year.
Transfer Fee | An amount equal to $1,000 multiplied the number of Franchised Salons then. | Concurrently with the transfer | Payable as compensation for the expenses and resources required to review and approve the transfer...
Successor Development Term Fee | An amount equal to $1,000 multiplied the number of Salons that you agree to cause to be opened during the successor development term. | Upon renewal | Payable only if you seek a successor development term.
Insurance Premiums | Estimated to be $2,000 to $4,000 (for 3 months), plus 15%. | Upon demand | Payable only if you do not maintain the required insurance coverages...
Costs and Attorneys' Fees | Will vary under circumstances. | Upon demand | If you default under your agreement, you must reimburse us for the expenses we incur...
Indemnification | Will vary under circumstances. | Upon demand | You must defend, hold us harmless, and reimburse us for the damages we incur...
Contribution for Legal Actions | 40% of the reasonable attorneys' fees and costs we incur | Upon demand | Incurred if we bring legal action to enforce our rights under, or to defend claims relating to, any Franchised Salons in your Territory.
